newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Visco gives budget fiscal measures.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Visco gives budget fiscal measures.

text.p: Finance Minister Vincenzo Visco said that the Italian mini-budget approved on Thursday included 4.2 trillion lire of revenue from assorted fiscal measures.
He said advance payment of taxes would bring in 3.0 trillion lire while 1.2 trillion lire would be raised by simplifying the procedures for paying inheritance tax.
Fiscal measures also included incentives for businesses investing in innovation, with credits worth 500 billion lire.
Prime Minister Romano Prodi said earlier the overall mini-budget included 15.5 trillion lire of deficit cuts. -- Rome newsroom +39 6 678 2501
